testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select an assembly template in list view ✔> Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-native-candidate.opj` as its active project ✔> And the native catalog contains metric and inch templates in their respective folders ✔> And the catalog root has no direct template files ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user presses Control+N to open the new-document template chooser ✔ And the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the metric template folder is selected ✔ And templates are grouped by type ✔ When the user chooses List in the template display menu ✔ Then the gallery displays compact template entries under type headings ✔ And the template details pane remains visible ✔ When the user selects the standard metric assembly template in the list ✔ Then the details pane identifies an assembly with millimeter units ✔ When the user chooses Medium icons in the template display menu ✔ Then the gallery displays medium-sized template icons ✔ And the details pane continues to identify the metric assembly template
